title: AI Shield

source.note: Ported page for page from the live prototype's AI Shield module (its /shield routes). Same screens, words, data and behaviour; built from the Lepide Design System kit.

entry.action: Click the featured "AI Shield" card (tag New) on Home, or "AI Shield" in the sidebar (Modules)

routes.note: Navigation state { filter: 'review' } opens it on the Needs review filter.

frame.breadcrumb: Home › AI Shield › <tab> (Overview: Home › AI Shield)
frame.tabsNote: A tab bar under the page header (role=tablist, arrow keys move). Sessions shows a count badge of sessions that still need review.
frame.sidebar: AI Shield sits first under Modules, with a sub-menu: Sessions, People, Protection policy.

screens.title: AI Shield
layout: Status strip: N approvers in place (Manage people) · X of Y endpoints protected (Server) · Policy version N (Review policy)
KPI cards: Endpoints protected · Sessions this week (N need review) · High-risk activity blocked (7 days) · AI tools in use

Panels: Sessions this week (columns by day) · What happened (donut of outcomes, last 7 days) · Needs your review (open sessions) · Agents needing attention (Endpoints) · Admin activity (30-day band + latest two, All activity)

screens.title: Sessions
screens.rowOpen: Opens the session detail panel beside the table

primary.label: Mark as reviewed
primary.when: outcome is Needs review and not yet reviewed
primary.does: Marks it reviewed, logs Admin activity, toast "Session reviewed"

screens.title: People

rowMenu.label: Edit
rowMenu.disabledWhen: Owner ("Owners are managed by an Owner")

rowMenu.label: Remove
rowMenu.disabledWhen: Owner, or yourself ("You can't remove yourself")

screens.rows: People who left the directory are shown disabled.

screens.title: Protection policy
layout: Header chip: Version N; description: N policies watching N keywords · published <when>
Legend card: Risk level (Low, Medium, High, Critical) and When it's found (Allow, Warn user, Block, Block & report)
One card per policy (9): title, blurb, risk chip, units chip, first 5 keywords (+N more), When found dropdown, N keywords, Edit

screens.title: Server
cards: Console (Running): Console URL + Copy, Certificate, Service, Version, Install path
Where data is stored: Database, Server, Port, Database name; Test connection → Connected · 12 ms
Where old data goes: Retention (1/3/6/9 months), After retention (archive / delete permanently); Discard + Save changes
Where admins and endpoints come from: Identity source (Connected), Domain, Service account, Last sync; Sync now
Licence: Licence id, Registered by, Activated, Expires, Endpoint seats meter; Activate another licence (toast: not part of this prototype yet)

dialogs.title: Add person
dialogs.primary: Add person → toast "<name> added" (directory accounts are Invited until their first sign-in)

gettingBackIn.local: Reset password → a one-time password shown once, with Copy
gettingBackIn.directory: Password lives in the directory; "Simulate: they leave the organisation" → Left the directory

dialogs.title: Remove <name>?
dialogs.primary: Remove <first name> → toast "Person removed"; approvers get a different warning

dialogs.title: <policy title>

fields.label: Keywords
fields.note: Enter or comma adds; Backspace on empty removes the last

dialogs.primary: Apply to draft (the change is published from the page)

dialogs.title: Version N is ready to publish
dialogs.primary: Publish version N → toast "Version N published"; Discard resets the draft

data.store: src/modules/shield/store.ts — in memory; a page reload restores the seed data
data.every change: is written to Admin activity (who, action, details, type)

notBuilt: Activate another licence (shows a toast: not part of this prototype yet)
Owner-only server settings (console URL, certificate, database) are read-only here
